what_this_is: The high and critical advisories `pnpm audit --prod --json` reported for each frontend lockfile on the day they were last regenerated (15-11-2026, after the upgrade to Next 15.5.28; first taken 30-09-2026), reduced to (id, package, version, severity). tests/test_dependencies_are_audited_and_watched.py asserts each baseline names every one of them that affects a version its lockfile still holds.
how_to_regenerate: from the repo root, for APP in web marketing: (cd apps/$APP && pnpm audit --prod --json > /tmp/$APP.json); then python3 apps/api/scripts/ci/audit_gate.py --kind pnpm --report /tmp/$APP.json --baseline /dev/null --print-baseline lists what the baseline must hold; rewrite the matching `advisories` array below as {id, package, version, severity} for every finding at high or above.
